licence_flags.finding: Piper x4: same lessac research-licence derivation chain.

Falcon-H1 ships license=other / falcon-llm-license with NO LICENSE FILE IN THE REPO. The cited URL (falconllm.tii.ae/falcon-terms-and-conditions.html) contains ZERO occurrences of 'Falcon H1' -- it covers Falcon 2 11B, Falcon 180B, Falcon Mamba 7B and Falcon 3 only. The governing terms for this exact model are therefore NOT ESTABLISHED. Additionally the Acceptable Use Policy is defined as 'the latest version from time to time' and the licence states 'You should monitor the web address at which the Acceptable Use Policy is hosted' -- a unilaterally mutable, forward-binding obligation, which cannot be discharged for an already-shipped offline device. Archived: licences/falcon-terms-and-conditions_2026-08-02.txt

the_real_threat_is_not_arithmetic.statement: Every bytes/4 doubling hazard for Q and F is now dead, and every backbone row is EXACT. Q and F are arithmetically SAFER than the plan recorded. They are not SAFE, and the reason is row Q9/F9.
the_real_threat_is_not_arithmetic.finding: facebook/omniASR-CTC-300M's tokenizer is CHARACTER-LEVEL and contains ZERO punctuation tokens.
the_real_threat_is_not_arithmetic.evidence: Exhaustive byte scan of the 87,562 B omniASR_tokenizer.model sentencepiece blob: 0 occurrences of '.', ',', '?', '!', ';', ':'. Digits and CJK/Cyrillic/Greek/Khmer characters ARE present, so the scan is sound.
the_real_threat_is_not_arithmetic.consequence: A punctuation/ITN source is ARCHITECTURALLY REQUIRED for Q and F -- not 'more likely to be non-zero' as section 2.4a put it, but mandatory.
the_real_threat_is_not_arithmetic.conclusion: NEITHER Q NOR F CAN AFFORD THE CHEAPEST NEURAL PUNCTUATION RESTORER THIS LANE COULD FIND. They stay under cap only if punctuation and ITN are delegated to the backbone LLM at zero additional parameters. That is a BINDING ARCHITECTURAL CONSTRAINT and must be asserted at build time, not assumed.
the_real_threat_is_not_arithmetic.verdict_consequence: Q and F are UNVERIFIED, not COMPLIANT.

g2pw_hazard_now_exactly_sized.comment: g2pW is bert-base-chinese plus a polyphone head. The 102,882,442 gross figure section 3.10 quotes is confirmed to the parameter. Q's headroom is 34.5% of it; F's is 23.7%.
g2pw_hazard_now_exactly_sized.avoidable: Yes. Q7/F7 already specify pypinyin (rule-based, 0 params). g2pW is an upgrade path, not a requirement. Neither stack should take it.
